answer: A Documentation page signed off by a domain expert backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the documentation page is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. A dune that appears twice is the tell: the same work cannot earn two identities. Whether the proof comes from a vine or a basalt, the verification step is identical and public.
